• 2 pounds chicken thighs
  • 1 teaspoon salt
  • 1 teaspoon pepper
  • 2 tablespoons olive oil
  • 1 onion, diced
  • 3 cloves garlic, minced
  • 2 cups orzo
  • 4 cups chicken broth
  • 2 lemons
  • 1 teaspoon oregano
  • 2 cups spinach

Instructions

Season the chicken.
Brown the chicken in olive oil.
Saute the onion and garlic.
Simmer the orzo in broth.
Return chicken and finish with lemon and spinach.
